target.exact_identity: LightCarbon SPEEDZ complete build recorded with Shimano 105 mechanical 2x12

sources_checked.result: The current manufacturer page identifies LCR017-D and includes an HBR17 integrated handlebar in that frameset package. It does not map that frame to the published SPEEDZ complete build or its 105 mechanical 2x12 configuration.

The catalog maps 速7 to LCR017-D but lists HBR14 sizing for that entry. It does not map SPEEDZ to 速7 or specify the exact complete build. This also differs from the current product page's HBR17 frameset package; neither package is transferred to SPEEDZ.

field_result.finding: Three fresh web approaches did not identify the cockpit fitted to the exact SPEEDZ complete build. The prior three public-post searches were carried forward; they found no exact opened cockpit claim. A public search result for the project's separate Speed7 lead is not independent evidence. No component value was added.
field_result.reopen_when: An official source or opened exact public listing ties the SPEEDZ 105 mechanical 2x12 complete build to the frame/model and names its configured cockpit.
